To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the DG investment in the studied network area is a profitable business opportunity for new entrants.

DG can be a business opportunity in primary distribution networks, and that it is a viable option to increase the competitiveness in the electricity sector, by providing a more efficient and reliable network, while reducing the investment in network expansion.

DG business opportunities can be identified by analyzing the impact of DG on the network, and by considering the economic impact on both, the incumbent distribution company (DC) and new entrants (DG investors).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology for the economic evaluation of DG investment opportunities in primary electricity distribution network.
the impact on business opportunities and dynamic competition of distributed generation in electricity distribution networks.
the development of a business case for DG, and the impact on the existing distribution network.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, DG can be a profitable investment for new investors, and a solution to the network expansion needs, if adequate rules to integrate it are defined.
the DG is an alternative to network reinforcement, which is economically viable for both, new and incumbent agents.
the business opportunities for DG in the network area, in the short term, is a feasible and profitable business.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DG in the distribution network has the potential to improve the reliability, to reduce the losses and to increase the voltage quality.
DG can be a profitable business for the distribution company, the end users and the DG owner.
, the DG solution analyzed determines an opportunity for new investors, while end users are also benefitted.   1.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current regulatory model does not allow the development of DG as an opportunity for new entrants in the electricity distribution sector.
the business opportunities to invest on DG in the electricity distribution networks are not only for the incumbent distribution company but also for new entrants.
, in a competitive electricity market, DG can be an attractive investment for new entrants.
